mentions.name: TUI framework for tokamak
mentions.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) framework for tokamak, being built so it can be used to power a local agent harness. Its proof of concept currently lives in a separate Codeberg repository (hello-tui).
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a TUI framework for tokamak https://github.com/cztomsik/tokamak so I can then use it for my local agent harness. The currently separate PoC now lives in codeberg https://codeberg.org/cztomsik/hello-tui
